title: Search a 2D Matrix
statement: Each row of the matrix is sorted, and the first element of each row is greater than the last element of the previous row. Return true when `target` is present.
hints: The matrix is a sorted array written in rows.
Binary search the index range 0 .. m*n - 1.
Index k lives at row k // n and column k % n.

approaches.name: Binary search each row
approaches.explanation: Find the row, then search it.

approaches.name: One binary search
approaches.explanation: Treat the matrix as a flat sorted array.

editorial: Map a flat index to a cell and run an ordinary binary search. The row-start condition is what makes the flat sequence sorted, so the usual halving argument applies. A staircase search from the top-right is the algorithm for the different problem where each row and each column is sorted but rows do not continue each other.
